what_it_is: The MQ-9B SeaGuardian/SkyGuardian is General Atomics' next-generation maritime and land RPAS: a 40-hour-endurance, certification-oriented MALE platform with multi-mode radar, EO/IR and anti-submarine-warfare kit options. It is the export-optimised successor to the MQ-9 Reaper lineage.
india_angle: The US State Department approved a potential ~$3.9B sale of 31 MQ-9B drones to India in February 2024 (15 SeaGuardians for the Navy, 16 SkyGuardians for Army/Air Force split), following the June 2023 announcement during Modi's state visit. This is one of the largest Indian UAS programmes on record.

intelligence_assessment: The FMS approval is officially documented by US sources; Indian contract signature, MRO investments and GA-ASI facility commitments in India are the follow-on facts to track. Watch delivery schedules against India's indigenous MQ-9B-class ambitions (DRDO's Archer-NG).

faq.a: A potential sale of 31 MQ-9B (Navy SeaGuardians plus Army/IAF SkyGuardians) was approved by the US State Department in February 2024 at an estimated ~$3.9B.
